question: Which Indian city has the Nilachal Hills?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Guwahati.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The Kamakhya Devi Temple is one of the main 51 Shakti Peethas in the country.
 
• It is situated on the Nilachal Hills in Guwahati, Assam.
 
• It is believed to be the place where the Yoni of Goddess Sati fell.
